title: 第9章 暗中手脚第10章 寒门书楼
slug: 苟住开局长生修仙只是副业
content_zh:
拿着食盒，从乙字房开始送起。
“大人，用膳了！”
“今天怎么送得这么晚？！”
乙二十六号房的是翰林院的一位翰林，因为写了反诗，被关了进来，平时和林铭说话的时候，也是温文尔雅，当真是有几分书生气度！
“大人，小的那边有些其他事情，稍微耽误了一点时间，对不住大人，大人，您先用膳，我还得抓紧去送其他大人的！”
“去吧，去吧！”
翰林没有多说，挥挥手，示意林铭快去！
他打开食盒，将其中的饭食拿了出来，吃了起来！
……
一个个食盒送了过去，转眼就到了乙三十二号房，一看其中，正有一位五旬上下的富态老者端坐其中！
“此人应该就是齐熹！”
林铭心中有所判断，试探着说道：
“齐大人，用膳了！”
“嗯！”
齐熹点了点头，答应一声，向着林铭这边走了过来。
确定了他的身份，林铭也不和他多言，继续转身回转厨房，拿着其他人的食盒一一送了起来。
当他将乙字号的饭食全部送完，再回来拿甲字号的饭食，齐大厨那边也已然是将陈相公子的饭食做好，再次叮嘱着：
“林铭，这个是陈相公子的，可千万别送错了！”
“明白！”
林铭答应一声，拿着陈相公子的食盒，前往甲三房，房门依旧开着，外牢房坐着两名护卫，陈相公子在内牢房休息！

见林铭来了，一名护卫吩咐着：
“老规矩，你尝一下，然后在一旁等上一刻钟，没问题，你就可以走了！”
“是，大人！”
林铭也早有预计，并不意外，按照对方的吩咐，每样饭菜都尝了一口，连带着酒水也抿了一口，放下碗筷，站到一旁，等了一刻钟之后，拱手告知两名护卫一声，这才默默退走。
林铭这边退走之后，继续将甲字号剩余的几个犯人送完，这才算是松了一口气！
和齐大厨告知一声，陈相公子这边无事！
这才从天牢后门离去，前往药铺，买了一些泻药！
再回转天牢休息处，和诸多狱卒吹牛聊天，时不时混入到那些耍钱的人之中，跟着呼喊几声大小！
……
一转眼，到了小食时间！
国朝一天两餐，上午叫做大食，下午叫做小食！
小食前一刻，林铭就提前前往后厨，齐大厨已经将陈相公子的饭食准备出来，他先拿着食盒，给陈相公子先送了过去。
送完了陈相公子，再去送其他人的……
送到齐熹的时候，林铭将提前买好的泻药，放了一小部分进去！
content_en:
Take the food box and start delivering it from Room B.
"Sir, it's time to eat!"
"Why is the delivery so late today?!"
The person in Room B, No. 26, was a member of the Hanlin Academy. He was imprisoned because he wrote an anti-poetry. When he usually talked to Lin Ming, he was also gentle and elegant, and he really had a bookish attitude!
"Sir, I have some other things over there, which delayed me a little bit. I'm sorry, sir. Sir, you have your meal first. I have to hurry up and see off the other adults!"
"Go, go!"
Hanlin didn't say much, and waved his hand, signaling Lin Ming to go quickly!
He opened the food box, took out the food, and started eating!
…
Food boxes were delivered one by one, and in a blink of an eye, they arrived at Room B 32. When they saw it, there was a wealthy old man in his fifties sitting in it!
"This person should be Qi Xi!"
Lin Ming made a judgment in his mind and said tentatively:
"Master Qi, it's time to eat!"
"Yeah!"
Qi Xi nodded, agreed, and walked towards Lin Ming.
After confirming his identity, Lin Ming didn't say much to him, and continued to turn around to the kitchen, taking the food boxes of other people and delivering them one by one.
When he had delivered all the meals in size B and came back to get the meals in size A, Chef Qi had already prepared Mr. Chen's meals and warned him again:
"Lin Ming, this belongs to Mr. Chen, please don't give it to the wrong one!"
"Understood!"
Lin Ming agreed, took Prime Minister Chen's food box, and headed to Room A and Three. The door was still open. Two guards were sitting in the outer cell. Mr. Chen was resting in the inner cell!
Seeing Lin Ming coming, a guard ordered:
"Old rules, you have a taste, then wait aside for a quarter of an hour, no problem, you can go!"
"Yes, sir!"
Lin Ming had expected this, and was not surprised. Following the other party's instructions, he tasted every meal and took a sip of the wine. He put down his bowls and chopsticks and stood aside. After waiting for a quarter of an hour, he handed over his hands to the two guards and then silently retreated.
After Lin Ming retreated, he continued to send away the remaining prisoners in Category A, and then he breathed a sigh of relief!
Let Chef He Qi tell you that Mr. Chen is fine here!
Then he left through the back door of Tianlao, went to the drug store, and bought some laxatives!
Then we went back to the Tianlao rest area and chatted with many jailers. From time to time, we mixed in with those who played for money and shouted a few times!
…
In a blink of an eye, it’s snack time!
There are two meals a day in Guochao. The morning is called a big meal and the afternoon is called a snack!
Moments before snacks, Lin Ming went to the kitchen in advance. Chef Qi had already prepared Mr. Chen's meal. He took the food box and sent it to Mr. Chen first.
After sending Mr. Chen off, I’m going to send others away...
When delivering it to Qi Xi, Lin Ming put a small portion of the laxative he had bought in advance into it!
